setting.sl: Vaška trgovina (v Avstriji: der Nahversorger) bo ob koncu leta zaprla vrata. Najbližja trgovina je dvanajst kilometrov stran, mnogi starejši pa nimajo avta. S sosedi ste zbrali podpise in imate idejo. Greš na uradne ure k županu, da mu razložiš težavo in predlagaš rešitev.
setting.en: The village shop (in Austria, the Nahversorger) closes at the end of the year. The nearest supermarket is twelve kilometres away, and many older people have no car. With your neighbours you've collected signatures, and you have an idea. You go to the mayor's office hours to explain the problem and propose a solution.
setting.it: La bottega di alimentari del paese (in Austria il Nahversorger) chiuderà a fine anno. Il supermercato più vicino è a dodici chilometri e molti anziani non hanno la macchina. Con i vicini avete raccolto delle firme e avete un'idea. Vai al ricevimento del sindaco per spiegargli il problema e proporre una soluzione.

role: Bürgermeister Wutti, the mayor, at his office hours. Friendly, busy, a careful politician: asks for numbers (who shops there, who would run it), raises the budget, the supermarkets in Villach and that the council decides; promises only to put a written plan on the council's agenda. Says Sie.

goals.en: Propose a solution and argue for it

opener_sl: Grüß Gott, kommen Sie herein, nehmen Sie Platz. Ich hab eine Viertelstunde, dann ist Gemeindevorstand. Also, wo drückt der Schuh?

opener_en.sl: Dober dan, vstopite, sedite. Imam četrt ure, potem imam sejo. No, kje vas čevelj žuli?
opener_en.en: Good afternoon, come in, take a seat. I've got a quarter of an hour, then the council board meets. So, what's the trouble?
opener_en.it: Buongiorno, entri, si accomodi. Ho un quarto d'ora, poi c'è la giunta. Allora, qual è il problema?
